workarounds.symptom: Retain failures (execution errors, client cancellation, worker timeouts) leak unreferenced attachments in storage
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(attachments): a daily sweep deletes the attachments of retains that failed (#6350). Target files: hindsight-api-slim/hindsight_api/admin/cli.py, hindsight-api-slim/hindsight_api/alembic/_owned.py, hindsight-api-slim/hindsight_api/alembic/versions/05867433a58c_add_banks_with_attachments_in_window_routine.py. The API stores a retain's images and files **before** the retain runs (the async path can't carry the bytes in its operation row). If the retain then fails — LLM error, client disconnect, a worker giving up — n... (Ref: https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/6474)

workarounds.symptom: coding-agents: recall/reflect query is built from the raw prompt, including injected <system-reminder> blocks, so fallback recall can miss the user's words
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(coding-agents): strip host-injected tags from the prompt before recall/reflect. Target files: hindsight-integrations/coding-agents/src/core/hook.test.ts, hindsight-integrations/coding-agents/src/core/hook.ts, hindsight-integrations/coding-agents/src/core/runtime.test.ts. Some hosts (e.g. the Claude desktop app) put a `<system-reminder>` block before the user's words in the prompt. The prompt hook used it as-is, so the recall query (cut to ~1,000 chars from the start) and the reflect goal were mostly host boilerplate. (Ref: https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/6491)

workarounds.symptom: 1.2.0 ollama-cloud regression: schema tool turns and misleading done error on GPT-OSS/DeepSeek
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(llm): reflect tool turns and vision retain never send two user turns in a row (#6349). Target files: hindsight-api-slim/hindsight_api/engine/llm_wrapper.py, hindsight-api-slim/hindsight_api/engine/providers/openai_compatible_llm.py, hindsight-api-slim/hindsight_api/engine/providers/tools_via_schema.py. Strict chat templates (Gemma's under llama.cpp `--jinja` or vLLM) refuse two user messages in a row with "Conversation roles must alternate". Hindsight sent them in two places: (Ref: https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/6468)

workarounds.symptom: [1.2.0] Reflect agent: intermediate tool calls fail with "requires ..." when provider returns unparseable tool-call args (only `done` gets the _raw repair)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(llm): check a tool call's reply against its function, correct it once (#6420, #6302). Target files: hindsight-api-slim/hindsight_api/engine/llm_wrapper.py, hindsight-api-slim/hindsight_api/engine/providers/tools_via_schema.py, hindsight-api-slim/tests/test_tools_via_schema.py. Every tool call is a reply to a response schema (#6176), but nothing checked that the reply *is* a call (`skip_validation=True`). On an endpoint that does not enforce the schema — Ollama Cloud, or Gemini ignoring `additionalProperties` — a m... (Ref: https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/6469)

workarounds.symptom: CLI 0.10.3: documented failed outcome is rejected and stored error text causes a false HTTP 500
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(clients,cli): forward-compatible decoding and bounded export polling. Target files: hindsight-cli/src/api.rs, hindsight-cli/src/errors.rs, hindsight-clients/go/content_marshal_test.go. — the Go client no longer rejects unknown response fields: `generate-clients.sh` strips the generator's `DisallowUnknownFields()` from every model, and the client is regenerated. Required-field checks stay. (Ref: https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/5515)
